title: Mouseover tooltip should include the current microphone volume
line: The microphone tray icon's tooltip now shows the current microphone volume, like the volume icon does.
explanation: The microphone indicator that appears in the system tray while an app records audio set its tooltip title to just "Microphone" (or "Microphone Muted"), so the only way to see the level was to scroll and watch the OSD. The speaker icon's tooltip, by contrast, says "Volume at N%". The change sets the title to "Microphone volume at N%" for the preferred microphone, reusing the percentage already computed for the icon; it keeps "Microphone Muted" when all microphones are muted and plain "Microphone" when there is no preferred source.

commits.message:
microphoneindicator: show the microphone volume in the tooltip

The microphone tray icon's tooltip only said "Microphone", while the
volume icon's tooltip shows the current volume and updates while
scrolling on it. Show "Microphone volume at N%" in the same way.

BUG: 526463
